name: Read the preserved native failed neutralization result without changing it

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local s=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.ReadEnemy(); local ref=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY'),'saved spy reference missing'); assert(s.spy.id==ref.id and s.spy.owner==ref.owner,'read changed the saved spy identity'); if s.spy.present then local unit=assert(Players[ref.owner]:GetUnits():FindID(ref.id),'claimed spy is missing'); assert(unit:GetID()==ref.id and unit:GetOwner()==ref.owner and unit:GetType()==GameInfo.Units['UNIT_SPY'].Index,'lookup resolved another native spy') else assert(s.spy.operation==nil and s.spy.endTurn==nil and s.spy.remaining==nil and s.spy.x==nil and s.spy.y==nil,'absent spy inherited another unit details') end; return 'saved spy identity checked; lookup='..tostring(s.spy.lookupID)..' saved='..tostring(ref.id)
